window-1.title: Orb Farm
window-1.blurb: It's a tiny sealed pixel ecosystem you seed with sand, algae and little shrimp and then fuss over for hours — basically a side quest in a jar, and I know you'll name the fish.

window-2.title: The end of short-form content — Embedded
window-2.blurb: Kate Lindsay calls the time of death on the endless scroll and makes the case for going long — which feels like permission for exactly the kind of elaborate, deep-dive side quests you already throw yourself into.

window-3.title: Pandan Mocktail
window-3.blurb: Pandan is your hometown flavour — grassy, vanilla-sweet, kueh-coded — and steeping it into a bright green mocktail feels like the drink version of one of your heritage remixes, begging to be styled with a silly straw and shot on flash.

window-4.title: Berghain As An Apartment, Suntanned Furniture, a Parisian Tiny House, and More
window-4.blurb: Someone built their apartment to feel like Berghain and honestly that's the most Melany-coded commitment to a bit I've seen all week — plus sun-bleached furniture and a tiny Parisian house to steal ideas from.

window-5.title: Wok & Toast 街坊, Serangoon
window-5.blurb: The Neighbourwok crew just opened a kopitiam-meets-wok-kitchen called 街坊 — literally "neighbour" — where $5.80 kaya toast sets share a counter with proper charred Hokkien mee, and it's exactly the kind of unglamorous heritage remix you'd end up photographing on film and building a whole mood around.
